benefits.name: Disabled Veteran Property Tax Exemption
benefits.description: South Dakota exempts $200,000 of a dwelling's full and true value from property taxation for veterans rated as permanently and totally disabled from a service-connected disability, provided the veteran owns and occupies the property. Surviving spouses (who have not remarried) of a veteran who was permanently and totally disabled, or who receive dependency and indemnity compensation from the VA due to the veteran's service-connected death, may claim a $150,000 exemption on an owner-occupied dwelling. Applicants must apply annually on a form prescribed by the Secretary of Revenue with the local County Director of Equalization; those missing deadlines may petition the county commissioners for tax abatement.
benefits.value: $200,000 of dwelling value exempt (permanently and totally disabled veteran); $150,000 exempt (qualifying surviving spouse)

otherReqs: Surviving spouse loses exemption upon remarriage
Application filed annually on a form prescribed by the Secretary of Revenue

application.agency: South Dakota Department of Revenue / County Director of Equalization
documentation: VA rating letter confirming permanent and total service-connected disability

benefits.name: Disabled Veteran Specialty License Plate
benefits.description: South Dakota resident veterans who are a recipient of a VA 'K' Award, a recipient of an automobile under Public Law 187, a recipient of a statutory benefit for loss or loss of use of one or more extremities, or a recipient of a veteran's allotment for total disability from a service-connected injury (incurred in active duty during wartime or a military mission involving armed conflict) may obtain a Disabled Veteran specialty plate. The plate costs a one-time $10 fee plus a $12 mailing fee, with a $10 annual renewal fee, and no standard vehicle registration fee is charged. Plates are issued upon verification of Disabled Veteran status through the VA in Sioux Falls; if the applicant does not qualify, the $10 fee is refunded.
benefits.value: $10 initial fee plus $12 mailing fee; $10 annual renewal; no standard registration fee charged

otherReqs: Must be a motor vehicle or motorcycle owner
Verification of Disabled Veteran status through the VA office in Sioux Falls required

application.agency: South Dakota Department of Revenue, Motor Vehicle Division
documentation: VA certification of qualifying disability status (K Award, statutory extremity-loss benefit, Public Law 187 vehicle grant, or total service-connected disability allotment)

benefits.name: Reduced Fee Hunting/Fishing License for Disabled Veterans
benefits.description: South Dakota offers a reduced-fee hunting and fishing license to disabled veterans who have a total disability (limited to a wheelchair and permanently physically unable to walk), or who provide a letter from the VA indicating receipt of a 'K' award or a veteran's allotment for a total (40 percent) service-related disability, or who provide documentation of 40% Social Security disability plus verified active duty service, or who are documented former prisoners of war. This session could not confirm the exact discounted fee amount against a directly-read official source; the eligibility criteria and governing statute are confirmed on the official page.
benefits.value: Reduced-fee hunting/fishing license; exact discounted price not confirmed this session

otherReqs: Total disability (wheelchair-bound, permanently unable to walk), OR VA 'K' award / 40% service-related disability allotment letter, OR 40% Social Security disability plus verified active duty service, OR documented former POW status

application.agency: South Dakota Department of Game, Fish and Parks
documentation: Letter from the VA confirming K award or 40% service-related disability

benefits.name: Reduced/Free Tuition for Veterans
benefits.description: Under SDCL 13-55-2 to 13-55-5, South Dakota resident veterans (as defined in SDCL 33A-2-1) who are not eligible for GI Bill or other federal education benefits may take undergraduate courses at a state-supported university with reduced or waived tuition. Eligibility criteria include honorable discharge, South Dakota residency and in-state tuition qualification, and meeting one of several service criteria such as active duty after August 2, 1990, receipt of an Armed Forces Expeditionary Medal, or a service-connected disability rating of 10% or more. Eligible veterans receive one month of free tuition per month of qualifying service, with a minimum of one and a maximum of four academic years.
benefits.value: One month of free tuition per month of qualifying service (minimum 1, maximum 4 academic years)

otherReqs: Not eligible for GI Bill or other federal education payments
Honorably discharged South Dakota resident qualifying for in-state tuition
Must meet a qualifying service criterion (active duty post-8/2/1990, Armed Forces Expeditionary Medal, or 10%+ service-connected disability)

application.agency: South Dakota Board of Regents / South Dakota Department of Military and Veterans Affairs
documentation: DD-214 or proof of qualifying service
VA disability rating letter (if qualifying via 10%+ disability)

benefits.name: Veterans' Preference in Public Employment
benefits.description: South Dakota grants honorably discharged veterans who are U.S. citizens and served under qualifying conditions (per SDCL 33A-2) preference for appointment, employment, and promotion at all levels of government, including state, counties, municipalities, and school districts. Applicants meeting minimum qualifications must be given an interview opportunity. Veterans cannot be disqualified based on age or physical impairment unless it prevents job performance, and service-connected disabled veterans receive preference over non-disabled veterans. Unmarried spouses of deceased service-connected veterans, and spouses of disabled veterans unable to exercise preference rights, are entitled to equivalent preference if they meet job qualifications.
benefits.value: Hiring/promotion preference and guaranteed interview at all levels of South Dakota government for qualified veterans

otherReqs: Honorably discharged U.S. citizen who served under qualifying conditions (SDCL 33A-2)
Service-connected disabled veterans receive preference over non-disabled veterans

application.agency: State of South Dakota / county, municipal, and school district governments
documentation: DD-214 or proof of honorable discharge and qualifying service
